description: Java entity class representing an order product in an e-commerce system, including fields for product details, relationships to order, attributes, prices, and downloads.

classes.name: OrderProduct
classes.description: Entity class modeling a product within an order, with fields for SKU, name, quantity, charge, and related attributes, prices, and downloads.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: getOrderAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of order attributes.
